classification.difficultyReason: Compare unequal package sizes by finding costs for a common quantity, including recognising equal value.

content.prompt: If you are shopping, which is the better buy?

children.label: a
children.prompt: 400 g of tinned peaches costing $\$6.40$, or 550 g costing $\$9.00$

answer.worked:
Compare the costs of 100 g.

For the 400 g tin:
$$\begin{align*}\text{Cost of 1 g}&=\frac{640}{400}\text{ cents}\\\text{Cost of 100 g}&=\frac{640}{400}\times100\text{ cents}\\\text{Cost of 100 g}&=160\text{ cents}.\end{align*}$$
For the 550 g tin:
$$\begin{align*}\text{Cost of 1 g}&=\frac{900}{550}\text{ cents}\\\text{Cost of 100 g}&=\frac{900}{550}\times100\text{ cents}\\\text{Cost of 100 g}&=\frac{1800}{11}\text{ cents}.\end{align*}$$
Since $160<\frac{1800}{11}$, the 400 g tin costing $\$6.40$ is the better buy.

children.label: b
children.prompt: 500 g of lychees costing $\$5.50$, or 300 g costing $\$3.40$

answer.worked:
Compare the costs of 100 g.

For the 500 g package:
$$\begin{align*}\text{Cost of 1 g}&=\frac{550}{500}\text{ cents}\\\text{Cost of 100 g}&=\frac{550}{500}\times100\text{ cents}\\\text{Cost of 100 g}&=110\text{ cents}.\end{align*}$$
For the 300 g package:
$$\begin{align*}\text{Cost of 1 g}&=\frac{340}{300}\text{ cents}\\\text{Cost of 100 g}&=\frac{340}{300}\times100\text{ cents}\\\text{Cost of 100 g}&=\frac{340}{3}\text{ cents}.\end{align*}$$
Since $110<\frac{340}{3}$, the 500 g package costing $\$5.50$ is the better buy.

children.label: c
children.prompt: 140 g of toothpaste costing $\$1.68$, or 180 g costing $\$2.16$

answer.worked:
Compare the costs of 100 g.

For the 140 g tube:
$$\begin{align*}\text{Cost of 1 g}&=\frac{168}{140}\text{ cents}\\\text{Cost of 100 g}&=\frac{168}{140}\times100\text{ cents}\\\text{Cost of 100 g}&=120\text{ cents}.\end{align*}$$
For the 180 g tube:
$$\begin{align*}\text{Cost of 1 g}&=\frac{216}{180}\text{ cents}\\\text{Cost of 100 g}&=\frac{216}{180}\times100\text{ cents}\\\text{Cost of 100 g}&=120\text{ cents}.\end{align*}$$
Both cost $\$1.20$ per 100 g, so they are the same value.
